desc: Explore residue-class, recursive, and convolution-based approaches.
Derive and verify the unordered-pair formula for each divisibility level \(S_k\), with correct diagonal handling.
Derive the telescoping or weighted-indicator relation converting the \(S_k\) values into the sum of odd parts.
Design an \(O(N\log \max A)\) implementation using residue frequencies and value sums.
Establish safe integer bounds and optimize Python grouping across powers of two.
Produce the final stdin/stdout solution and validate it against samples and edge cases.
